title: Unique Vessel Identifier (UVI)
description: Getting and displaying a UVI. Summarised from AMSA's guidance.

sources.title: Obtain and display a unique vessel identifier

items.title: Check whether you need to apply separately
items.detail: AMSA issues a UVI automatically when you first apply for a certificate of survey, a non-survey approval or a specific exemption, or notify an intention to build. Otherwise use AMSA's standalone UVI application.

items.title: Display the UVI within 21 days of it being issued
items.detail: Above the waterline on both sides, in a contrasting colour, readable from 30 metres (for example characters at least 10 cm high on a 10 metre vessel). Before launch for a vessel under construction.

items.title: Record the UVI in your vessel's details
Tell AMSA within 14 days if you sell the vessel or it is sunk or scrapped
